title: Tipsy cake
credit_meta: Scammell, Henry B. (1897). Cyclopedia of Valuable Receipts: A Treasure-House of Useful Knowledge for the Every-Day Wants of Life. St Louis: Planet Publishing
desc_meta: Drawing of a Typsy cake, a small decorated sponge cake, steeped in brandy and covered with almonds. P197 includes the recipe. Henry B. Scammell's 1897 handbook Cyclopedia of Valuable Receipts, a guide to all and sundry with 2000 illustrations.
